en.hubeali: Is’haq, from Al Aqra’a who said,

‘I wrote to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) asking him<sup>asws</sup> about the Imam<sup>asws</sup> whether he<sup>asws</sup> would experience wet dreams, and I said within myself after sending the letter, ‘The wet dreams are Satanic and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High has Sheltered His<sup>azwj</sup> Guardians<sup>asws</sup> from that’.

So the answer came, ‘The state of the Imams<sup>asws</sup> during the sleep is their<sup>asws</sup> state during the wakefulness. The sleep does not change anything from them<sup>asws</sup>, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Sheltered His<sup>azwj</sup> Guardians<sup>asws</sup> from the ordeal of the Satan<sup>la</sup> just as you discussed with yourself’.
